name: dev-bother-me-nope
description: Seven-step build pipeline: one long story in, then 1 create the sprint (intake, then a stochastic multi-model research fan-out of at least 5 independent researchers, one per lens, running on Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and Fable (each at least once), whose approaches one opus synthesizer scores by merit, consensus and cross-model agreement; any UI is then designed first in Claude Design and Jonathan picks one direction), 2 plan each story, 3 code only using the right python skill set and merge to dev: no test is written or run while coding, only lint and the type-check, 4 once all coding is done ask Jonathan whether to run a test cycle and, on yes, how many test, fix, test cycles he wants (he enters a number), 5 run exactly that many cycles: the first test run writes the plans' tests (full suite plus headless Playwright) with one code review beside it, each cycle fixes every failure and finding, each reproduced as a failing test first, then tests again, and whatever the last test run still finds is reported, never fixed, 6 report, then a silent retro turns what went wrong (review findings, test failures, fix rounds, overruns, Jonathan's corrections) into lessons the next run's briefs carry, and alert, 7 Jonathan decides: release? Yes runs the whole release in order: preflight, Supabase MAIN migrations already applied to dev, the version bump and changelog, dev merged into main and tagged, dev fast-forwarded so dev and main are the same commit, the Vercel production deploy, the GitHub release and a smoke check. No ends the run, and Jonathan decides what's next. The design pick, the test cycles and the release decision are the only questions. Fixers gate on lint, types and related tests; the full suite and the build run only in the test runs. Until the release it never deploys to Vercel (not even dev), merges to dev never build, and migrations go to the Supabase DEV database only; a deploy-guard hook enforces this while a run is active. Merges are merge commits only, never squash: every merged branch is deleted with every worktree that has it checked out, locally and on origin, and every PR merge deletes its source branch. "/dev-bother-me-nope learn" backfills lessons from past runs and proposes promoting the proven ones into the plugin on a branch Jonathan merges. "/dev-bother-me-nope:teach" feeds what any conversation taught into the same lessons: it summarizes the conversation's learnings, keeps the ones a bmn run would otherwise get wrong again, asks Jonathan once, then writes, checks, commits and pushes them to dev and exports the global ones.
